evals.prompt: Run /platform-sync — this repo has all three manifests: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, and .cursor-plugin/plugin.json
evals.expected_output: Should detect all three platform targets, invoke platform-sync-claude, platform-sync-codex, and platform-sync-cursor, then synthesize a Unified Improvement Plan with sections tagged [Claude Code], [Codex], and [Cursor]. Plan must list detection signals per platform and include concrete snippets and source URLs for each step.

evals.prompt: /platform-sync — this repo only has a .claude-plugin/ directory with a plugin.json. There is no .codex-plugin/ or .cursor-plugin/.
evals.expected_output: Should detect Claude Code via .claude-plugin/plugin.json, invoke only platform-sync-claude, and output an improvement plan tagged [Claude Code] only. Must not attempt to invoke platform-sync-codex or platform-sync-cursor.

evals.prompt: /platform-sync — I'm running this in a regular Next.js app repo. There is no plugin manifest, but the repo has CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and .cursor/rules/000-project.mdc.
evals.expected_output: Should detect Claude Code (CLAUDE.md), Codex (AGENTS.md), and Cursor (.cursor/rules/) without plugin manifests. Invoke platform-sync-claude, platform-sync-codex, and platform-sync-cursor. Must NOT output the 'no usage detected' stop message.

evals.prompt: /platform-sync — plain library repo with no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/, or any plugin manifest.
evals.expected_output: Should detect no AI coding assistant usage and output the exact 'No AI coding assistant usage detected' message from detection.md, then stop with no sub-skill invocations.
